ohms-law.title: «xx» Ohm’s Law
ohms-law.summary: «xx» Find out how voltage and current are related in a resistor.
ohms-law.step1: «xx» Place the DC supply, switch, resistor, ammeter and voltmeter on the bench.
ohms-law.step2: «xx» Connect the parts in one loop so the ammeter is in series with the resistor.
ohms-law.step3: «xx» Connect the voltmeter across the resistor.
ohms-law.step4: «xx» Close the switch and set a voltage on the supply.
ohms-law.step5: «xx» Press Record reading. Repeat at 5 different voltages.
ohms-law.step6: «xx» Look at the V–I graph. What do you notice?

series-parallel.title: «xx» Series and parallel resistors
series-parallel.summary: «xx» Build resistors in series and in parallel, then find their equivalent resistance.

series.step1: «xx» Place the supply, switch, R1, R2, ammeter and voltmeter on the bench.
series.step2: «xx» Connect R1 and R2 one after the other (in series) with the ammeter measuring the total current.
series.step3: «xx» Connect the voltmeter across R1 and R2 together.
series.step4: «xx» Close the switch and record 3 readings at different voltages.
series.step5: «xx» Work out the equivalent resistance, type it in and press Check.

parallel.step1: «xx» Keep the same parts on the bench.
parallel.step2: «xx» Rewire R1 and R2 side by side (in parallel) with the ammeter measuring the total current.
parallel.step3: «xx» Connect the voltmeter across the R1 and R2 pair.
parallel.step4: «xx» Close the switch and record 3 readings at different voltages.
parallel.step5: «xx» Work out the equivalent resistance, type it in and press Check.

practice-place-voltmeter.title: «xx» Put the voltmeter across the resistor
practice-place-voltmeter.goal: «xx» Add the voltmeter across the resistor, then record a reading.

practice-fix-voltmeter.title: «xx» Move the voltmeter
practice-fix-voltmeter.goal: «xx» The voltmeter is measuring the wrong part. Move it across the resistor and record a reading.

practice-meter-polarity.title: «xx» Turn the meters the right way
practice-meter-polarity.goal: «xx» Both meters are backwards. Fix the wires so the needles move forwards, then record a reading.

practice-three-readings.title: «xx» Take three readings
practice-three-readings.goal: «xx» Record readings at 2 V, 4 V and 6 V.

practice-gather-parts.title: «xx» Build it from scratch
practice-gather-parts.goal: «xx» Place every part, wire the circuit and record a reading.

practice-series-then-parallel.title: «xx» Series, then parallel
practice-series-then-parallel.goal: «xx» Wire R1 and R2 in series and record a reading. Then rewire them in parallel and record another.

practice-equivalent-resistance.title: «xx» Equivalent resistance
practice-equivalent-resistance.goal: «xx» Work out the equivalent resistance for three resistor pairs.

extension-ohms-law.goal: «xx» This circuit uses a 30 Ω resistor. Record readings at 3 V, 6 V, 9 V and 12 V.
